QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Stolen Items
QuestInfo.0: The crewman who prevented you from meeting Gilberto Daniella seems worried. Maybe you should see what's wrong?
QuestInfo.1: There was a robbery! Tepes, from the Daniella Merchant Union, left some goods at the trading post. Supposedly, he picked them up later, but he denied ever doing so.\r\nWhat a mystery! You decided to investigate, thinking that solving this debacle would get you a shot at meeting Gilberto. You should head over to the Trading Post.
QuestInfo.2: There was a robbery! Tepes, from the Daniella Merchant Union, left some goods at the trading post. Supposedly, he picked them up later, but he denied ever doing so.\r\nWhat a mystery! You decided to investigate, thinking that solving this debacle would get you a shot at meeting Gilberto. When you investigated at the Trading Post, they claimed Tepes picked up the goods himself. So... what really happened?
